IS 7983 : 2026 Liquid Toilet Cleaner - Hydrochloric Acid Based - Specification
ICS 71.100.40
ICS 71.100.40
CHD 25
CHD 25
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for hydrochloric acid based liquid toilet cleaner for toilet bowl made up of porcelain and of steel and cast-iron toilet bowl covered with a coating of acid-resistant porcelain enamel.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
